package_format: single-file JSON container, eight parts, with an embedded executable runtime
note: Design-system release. Adds Module 03 document_type_system and Module 10 component_layer_contract, type_metrics, figure_type_scale, figure_geometry_check and measured_pagination, and ships all of it as runnable runtime commands. Every threshold the runtime enforces is read from this package, so doctrine and enforcement cannot drift apart.

parts.note: 17 modules, 00-16. Design-system doctrine added to 03 and 10 in 2.9.0.
Sections 03, 28C and 30 name the executable runtime form. Prose remains authoritative.
TOKENIZED universal quotation master v1.7. Not deliverable as stored.

parts.format: JSON object, one entry per governed image
parts.note: header, seal, signature, watermark. Watermark newly registered in 2.7.0.
Deterministic hydration engine and round-trip verification values.

parts.format: embedded JSON object with python source string
parts.note: gssc_runtime v1.1, stdlib only. Adds figcheck, typeaudit, pagefill and designaudit. Exit 0 = PASS, 1 = FAILED.

parts.format: embedded JSON object -- schema and store config
parts.note: Module 15 tier-3 store config. Entries live in a sidecar file, not in the package.

integrity.hash_method: sha256 over json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=False).encode('utf-8') for object parts; sha256 over value.encode('utf-8') for string parts
integrity.note: Declared explicitly so any third party can reproduce every hash. In 2.6.0 the kernel and logo-repository hashes were not reproducible by any standard serialization.

adoption_record.required_action: Record management adoption of the Execution Protocol. Carried as an authoritative candidate from v1.1 through v1.9 without a recorded adoption.
adoption_record.pending_status: review_candidate awaiting GSSC management adoption; 2.9.0 remains the current production release until adopted_by and adopted_on are populated

quickstart.step_2: python gssc_runtime.py all GSSC_Master_Package.json   -> must print PASS.
quickstart.step_3: python gssc_runtime.py precedent GSSC_Master_Package.json   -> read prior design decisions.
quickstart.step_4: Attach the package and project evidence, then use the Standard Employee Command in Section 30.
quickstart.step_6: Open quotation.html in Chrome or Edge, print to PDF at A4, margins none, background graphics ON. Do NOT use LibreOffice: it silently prints the internal builder-card panel.
